N1.s: Nagamit mo na ang lahat ng %lld libreng cutling. Ituloy sa Cutling at i-unlock para ma-save ang bagong cutling.
N1.back: Used you already the all of 5 free cutling. Continue in Cutling and unlock so-that be-saved the new cutling.
N1.why: First sentence is S3's, word for word; the second has N8's shape (go to Cutling, unlock, so it is saved), with 'Ituloy' because the person is carrying on what they started; 'bagong cutling' names the item; 108 of 110.

N2.s: Nagamit mo na ang lahat ng %lld libreng cutling. I-unlock sa Cutling para makapag-save pa.
N2.back: Used you already the all of 5 free cutling. Unlock in Cutling so-that can-save more.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; 'sa Cutling' says where the unlock happens, since this reply cannot open it; 'makapag-save' is S7's verb; 'pa' (more) is the everyday word for carrying on; 87 of 90.

N3.why: 'May isa pang libre' says one free one is still there, which sounds like room left, where 'isa na lang' (only one left) would sound like a countdown; 28 of 30.

N4.why: 'Puno na' is K1's word for the free places being filled, and '5 sa 5' is how S5 and M4 say a count; both numbers stay in brief order; 25 of 30 with 5 and 5.

N5.s: Puno na, %lld sa %lld. I-unlock para ma-save.
N5.back: Full already, 5 of 5. Unlock so-that be-saved.
N5.why: Opens with N4's exact words so the bar reads as the next step; 'ma-save' is object-focus with the object left out, as Filipino does when the thing is in hand, so it means 'so it gets saved'; 39 of 40.

N6.why: The same button verb as S15, sitting where 'I-save' usually is; 8 of 10.

N7.s: Nagamit mo na ang lahat ng %lld libreng cutling. I-unlock ang Cutling para ma-save ito.
N7.back: Used you already the all of 5 free cutling. Unlock the Cutling so-that be-saved this.
N7.why: S3's opening again; 'ito' points at the item shown on the form below; 'I-unlock ang Cutling' is M1's command; 84 of 90.

N8.s: Itinabi muna ito para sa iyo. Buksan ang Cutling at i-unlock para ma-save.
N8.back: Set-aside for-now this for you. Open the Cutling and unlock so-that be-saved.
N8.why: 'Itinabi' (set aside) is what a person does with something they will hand over later, and 'muna' says it is waiting; 'para sa iyo' is the vocab's 'iyong' address; 74 of 80.
